problem_statement: Subtle concurrency race condition when accessing shared streaming response buffer across multiple async workers under high request concurrency.
reference_solution:
diff --git a/fastapi/responses.py b/fastapi/responses.py
--- a/fastapi/responses.py
+++ b/fastapi/responses.py
@@ -102,6 +102,8 @@ class StreamingResponse(Response):
+        async with self._lock:
+            chunk = await self._stream.read()
